Package com.compdfkit.core.signature

Class CPDFSignatureContainerResult

java.lang.Object
com.compdfkit.core.signature.CPDFSignatureContainerResult
public final class CPDFSignatureContainerResult extends Object
Immutable response from a container provider; success does not establish signature validity.

  • Method Details

    • success

      public static CPDFSignatureContainerResult success(byte[] containerDer)
      Creates a successful provider response containing the entire detached SignedData container.

      Include the signer certificate and required chain certificates in the container. Supply binary DER, not PEM, Base64 text or a raw RSA/ECDSA signature. The SDK checks structure and reserved size before writing; cryptographic validity and trust are reported separately by post-sign validation.

      Parameters:
      containerDer - complete CMS/PKCS#7 DER, copied defensively; null or empty is rejected by the signing operation as sdk.container.empty
      Returns:
      a response for the SDK to check and embed

    • failure

      public static CPDFSignatureContainerResult failure(String code, String message)
      Creates an explicit provider failure, which prevents publication of the signed PDF.
      Parameters:
      code - application error code; null or empty uses sdk.container.failed
      message - safe diagnostic text, without credentials; null or empty uses a generic message
      Returns:
      a failed response with no container bytes

    • isSuccess

      public boolean isSuccess()
      Returns whether the provider reported success, before SDK structure and validation checks.
      Returns:
      true for a success response; false for a failure response

    • getContainerDer

      public byte[] getContainerDer()
      Returns the complete container supplied by the provider.
      Returns:
      a defensive copy of the DER bytes, or an empty array on failure; never null

    • getErrorCode

      Returns the provider's diagnostic code.
      Returns:
      the failure code, or an empty string on success
